sharedDirection: Art-only portrait 2:3 illustrations for a shared web trading-card frame. One centered original magical relic per image, fully visible with generous space. Premium painterly detail, subtle ink and halftone texture, restrained geometric background, minimal black-and-white editorial styling with one accent color. No text, numbers, card border, logo, watermark, characters, or existing-game iconography.

artworks.name: Silver Seed
artworks.prompt: A singular luminous sculpted silver seed with a delicate stem, suspended above a small dark stone pedestal, pale blue light and a restrained salmon halo; simple cool blue and ivory geometric field.

artworks.name: Prism Gate
artworks.prompt: A floating square portal of four translucent glass panes, with red, green, blue, and yellow reflections, dark metal frame and luminous central seam; pale gray and soft green geometric field.

artworks.name: Neural Eye
artworks.prompt: A single emerald crystal lens held inside a dark graphite mechanical iris with fine circuitry and a luminous green core; pale gray and deep green geometric field.

artworks.name: Volt Crown
artworks.prompt: A sleek sculptural white-metal circlet crowned by branching red lightning crystal, with arcs of controlled electric energy; pale gray and muted salmon geometric field.

artworks.name: Wayfinder Key
artworks.prompt: An antique brass key fused with a subtle compass rose and orange glass inlay, floating above dark stone; warm gray and restrained orange geometric field.
